reason: I'd totally tap on a funny duck sock ad, but the second I see 'pay €4.99 to reserve, no delivery date' I'm out. I buy stuff in the moment because I want it now, not to wait for 99 other people to sign up.
objection: Why pay €4.99 just to reserve something that might never get made, with no idea when it shows up? I already have a drawer full of patterned socks, so I'm not waiting around for these.
would_change_my_mind: If I could just buy the Quack Pack and have it at my door within a week, I'd probably grab it on impulse, maybe as a gift.
